description:
Required Skills: 
 The primary responsibility of this position is to maintain the application’s Web services, Windows Services and SQL databases and stored procedures. This includes certifying upgrades to the environment, production support, and coding and testing fixes to production issues. Candidate may also be called on to assist with project initiatives. 
 Candidates should have experience with the following midrange skills: 
 Web services, Web applications and Windows services 
 .Net 2.0 
 .Net 4.5.2 
 C# 
 IIS 
 MS SQL Server and Stored Procedures 
 Repliweb 
 MQ 
 DB2 
 Candidates should have a minimum of 5 years’ experience working in a midrange environment. Some experience with mainframe environment is helpful. 
 
 Desired Skills: 
 Working knowledge in application Design & Development 
 Able to contribute to 1. Automation 2. Causal analysis 3. Develop shared/common solutions 
 Able to identify risks and mitigation 
 Comfortable working in a matrix environment 
 Prior experience of working with globally distributed teams 
 
 Visa Status: Green Card, US Citizen and H4 EAD(W2).

 Thanks & Regards,

Namratha Gandavarapu |Sr. IT Recruiter

Direct: 317-210-8733
